resource.mighty-dragon-shape: Retunes an INNATE SPELL frequency (shape-of-the-dragon grants Dragon Form 1/day), which lives on innateSpells.usesPerDay, not on a feat limit.
resource.determined-lore-seeker: Same: changes an innate spell's uses per day, not a feat limit.
resource.unbelievable-luck: Its target, Accidental Shot, is an Action, not a feat — usesUpgrade can only point at a feat.
resource.cunning-trickster-mask: Changes an ACTION COST (free action instead of a single action), not a frequency.
resource.unlimited-esoterica: Changes an ACTION COST; the once-per-round frequency it mentions is unchanged.
resource.school-of-unified-magical-theory: Changes how often Drain Bonded Item may be used, but it is a subclass option rather than a feat, so it has no usesUpgrade home.
resource.revolutionary-innovation: The once-per-round is inside ONE modification's prose (reload as a free action), not the feature's own frequency.
resource.kindle-inner-flames: The once-per-round Step belongs to ANYONE who sheds the embers, not to the character.
resource.improvise-strategy: The 1/day is a Special clause for a troop with a skirmish bond; a feat-wide limitedUses would wrongly cap the whole feat.
resource.sign-bound: A 13-row constellation table pairing a spell with a frequency AND an attribute boost per row — not a pick from a filterable pool, and the boost has nowhere to go.
resource.zodiac-bound: Same shape: a 12-row zodiac table, each row a spell + cadence + attribute.
